data.body: Research phase approved by the maintainer on 2026-08-17. The accepted conclusion is: deployment resolves SSM or any other external secret store before process startup; Rebar consumes provider-native authentication and narrowly scoped static secret carriers at adapter boundaries; operation-certificate signing accepts exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH (preferred) or multiline REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY; no application-owned SSM retrieval, universal secret broker, built-in keyring, or global environment allowlist is introduced. Static credentials rotate by restart/redeploy. Completed evidence includes five offline probe suites, three-container secret-volume/tmpfs probes, the 17-input consumer census, fingerprint exclusions, live Anthropic and Bedrock native-auth canaries, 139 focused regressions, Gitleaks, and hosted canaries. This closes RESEARCH and authorizes an ADR DRAFT plus an implementation epic; implementation and ADR merge remain gated by the ADR HOLD lifecycle.
